whenToUse: A single show/hide region, such as advanced form settings or a show-more list.
Any element as the trigger when there is no need to coordinate several sections.
avoidWhen: Several related sections where one opens at a time — use accordion.
Peer views of the same context — use tabs.
a11y: The trigger exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls, and the height animation respects reduced motion.
Make the trigger text describe what will be revealed.
